title: Non-Unitary Quantum Machine Learning: Fisher Efficiency Transitions from Distributed Quantum Expressivity
summary: Quantum machine learning has faced growing scrutiny over its practical advantages compared to classical approaches, particularly following dequantization results and large scale benchmarking studies that have challenged earlier optimistic claims. This work presents a systematic empirical evaluation of non unitary quantum machine learning implemented via the Linear Combination of Unitaries framework within hybrid quantum classical neural networks.
